rows.grounds: genitive plural of prajā, indicating those affected
locative singular of month name āśvina

items.question: What auspicious outcome arises for people in the month of Ashvina?
premises: The affected group is the people.
The result is auspicious from all sides.
items.inference: Therefore, the month of Ashvina brings universally auspicious results for people.
items.plain_english: In the month of Ashvina, there is indeed auspiciousness for people in every respect.
